name: The Smiths

whyMatters.en: Manchester four-piece that set jangle guitar and literary lyric as 1980s UK indie’s default; The Queen Is Dead (1986) is the peak album citation.
whyMatters.zh: 曼彻斯特四人组：把 jangle 吉他与文学歌词定为 1980 年代英国 indie 默认；The Queen Is Dead（1986）是峰值专辑引用。

essentialTracks.title: There Is a Light That Never Goes Out

note.en: Rickenbacker jangle + skippy drum intro; Rough Trade breakthrough single.
note.zh: Rickenbacker jangle + 跳拍鼓 intro；Rough Trade 突破单曲。

note.en: Vibrato/tremolo wall on twin guitars; densest Smiths production citation.
note.zh: 双吉他 vibrato/tremolo 墙；Smiths 最密制作引用。

scenes.track: There Is a Light That Never Goes Out

note.en: Queen Is Dead ballad: layered acoustics under baritone narrative.
note.zh: Queen Is Dead 谣曲：男中音叙事下的多层原声。

interviewQuotes.text: I want a song that sounds like a car crash.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Johnny Marr
interviewQuotes.source: On How Soon Is Now? · press excerpt

interviewQuotes.text: We were the only band that mattered.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Morrissey

lyricQuotes: To die by your side is such a heavenly way to die

shortBio.en: Morrissey / Marr indie; There Is a Light That Never Goes Out is the lasting single.
shortBio.zh: Morrissey / Marr 的 indie；There Is a Light That Never Goes Out 是长寿单曲。

body.en:
Formed 1982. Rough Trade singles and albums through Strangeways… pair Johnny Marr’s multi-tracked jangle with Morrissey’s baritone and UK-specific references—no synth-pop compromise.

There Is a Light That Never Goes Out (1986) is the entry. They are the bridge from post-punk to 1990s Britpop guitar bands that cite Marr’s voicings and Morrissey’s persona separately.
body.zh:
1982 年组建。Rough Trade 单曲与直至 Strangeways… 的专辑：Johnny Marr 多层 jangle 对 Morrissey 男中音与英国本土指涉——不做 synth-pop 妥协。

There Is a Light That Never Goes Out（1986）是入口。他们是后朋克到 1990 年代 Britpop 吉他乐队的桥：后者分别引用 Marr 声部与 Morrissey 人设。

title.en: Jangle + literary lyric as UK indie default
title.zh: Jangle + 文学歌词成为英国 indie 默认

body.en:
Marr’s Rickenbacker/tele layers and Morrissey’s first-person UK references replace synth-pop as the mid-80s indie export.

The Queen Is Dead (1986) is the album most later Britpop acts name.
body.zh:
Marr 的 Rickenbacker/Tele 叠层与 Morrissey 的第一人称英国指涉，取代 synth-pop 成 80 年代中期 indie 出口。

The Queen Is Dead（1986）是后来 Britpop 最常点名的专辑。

body.en:
1982–87 classic four never swaps singers. Breakup ends the brand; no reunion catalog.

Citation density is high for five studio albums.
body.zh:
1982–87 经典四人不换主唱。解散结束品牌；无重组目录。

五张录音室专的引用密度高。

title.en: This Charming Man: jangle as single

body.en:
1983 Rough Trade single: skippy drums, bright arpeggios, baritone over major-key bounce.

Entry grammar for UK indie guitar radio.
body.zh:
1983 Rough Trade 单曲：跳拍鼓、明亮分解和弦、大调弹跳上的男中音。

英国 indie 吉他电台的入口语法。

body.en:
Division of labor is explicit: Marr owns multi-guitar voicings and arrangements; Morrissey owns lyric and persona. Rourke’s melodic bass and Joyce’s dry kit keep songs short.

How Soon Is Now? stacks vibrato for density without abandoning song form.
body.zh:
分工明确：Marr 管多吉他声部与编曲；Morrissey 管词与人设。Rourke 旋律贝斯与 Joyce 干鼓保持短曲。

How Soon Is Now? 用 vibrato 堆密度而不丢歌曲形式。

body.en:
Marr’s production ambition for How Soon Is Now? and Morrissey’s absolutist interview lines document method and brand posture.

Quotes sit beside the records, not instead of them.
body.zh:
Marr 对 How Soon Is Now? 的制作野心与 Morrissey 的绝对访谈句，记录方法与品牌姿态。

引语旁证唱片，不替代唱片。

body.en:
Oasis and Blur inherit Marr’s chord voicings and Morrissey’s first-person UK lyric as separate toolkits. Stone Roses take jangle into Madchester tempo.

Smiths remain the 80s hinge into 90s UK guitar radio.
body.zh:
Oasis 与 Blur 分别继承 Marr 和弦声部与 Morrissey 第一人称英国歌词。Stone Roses 把 jangle 带进 Madchester 速度。

Smiths 仍是通向 90 年代英国吉他电台的 80 年代铰链。

note.en: Only studio lineup; five albums then split.
note.zh: 唯一录音室阵容；五专后解散。

note.en: Jangle single that fixed UK indie guitar grammar.
note.zh: 定下英国 indie 吉他语法的 jangle 单曲。

note.en: Literary lyric + multi-tracked jangle without synth-pop compromise.
note.zh: 文学歌词 + 多层 jangle，不做 synth-pop 妥协。
